meta.scope: Default configuration only (tile source = OpenStreetMap, no persisted user settings). Assertion: every network request initiated by the app runtime is allowed by this allowlist or the run FAILS.
limitations: External anchor navigation (OPC link, Google Maps links) is user opt-in; the sweep never clicks external anchors (hard rule).
The merge worker chunk is lazy-loaded only when merging; covered by static audit (no XHR/fetch; grep-enforced), not by runtime tap.
Requests from windows/popups opened by external navigation are not observed (opt-in).

tile.name: OpenStreetMap
tile.note: Default TileLayer host (TripMap + PlacesMap). Sends viewer IP + visible bbox to OSM — disclosed opt-in per README/Privacy UI.

surfaces: README.md 隐私声明 → 地图瓦片
